One should work __hard than__ others to succeed.
questions.solution:

• *Adjectives with two syllables can form the **comparative either by adding -er **or by **preceding the adjective with more.**__*

• We need to join the two parts with a conjunction. 
 
• **Than **is a conjunction while **to **is a preposition. 
 
• Hence, **option 1 or harder than **is the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Robin has __less marbles__ than George.

• Hence, **option 4 **or **fewer marbles **is the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

 

**Correct sentence__ - ***Robin has **__fewer marbles__** than George.*

questions.question: Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, each has a different age. P is older than only U and R. R is older than U. Q is older than S but younger than T. T is not the oldest among all. The age of how many persons is between the ages of Q and R?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step 1: P is older than only U and R.

Step 2: R is older than U.

**P > R > U**

Step 3:Q is older than S but younger than T. 

**T > Q > S**

questions.question: _______ demand for money arises mainly due to the uncertainty of future receipts and expenses.
questions.solution:

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• People hold money in cash for three motives: (i)** Transactions motive**, (ii)** Precautionary motive**, and (iii) **Speculative motive.**
 
• **Precautionary Motive:**
 
 
• **​**People often demand money as a precaution against an uncertain future.
 
• Unexpected expenses, such as medical or car repair bills, often require immediate payment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Transactions Motive**

 
• Demanding money arises from the fact that most** transactions involve an exchange of money. **
 
• The** total number of transactions** made in an economy tends to increase over time as income rises.
 
• As income or GDP rises,** the transaction demand for money also rises.**

**Speculative Motive**

 
• Demanding money arises in situations where** holding money is perceived to be less risky than the alternative of lending the money or investing it in some other asset.**
 
• The demand for an asset depends on **both its rate of return and its opportunity cost.**
 
• Money holdings provide** no rate of return and often depreciate in value due to inflation.**
 
• The opportunity cost of holding money is the** interest rate that can be earned by lending or investing one's money holdings.**

questions.question: What do you call the water holding compounds produced in large quantities by marine brown and red algae?

__
 
• **Hydrocolloids** are a class of food additives with broad applications in the food industry to develop structure in food ingredients.
 
• **Hydrocolloids** can be synthetic, plant-based, or animal-based. 
 
• Increasing consumer awareness has led to the use of natural food ingredients derived from natural sources, making algae-derived **hydrocolloids** more appealing nowadays. 
 
• **Algae-derived hydrocolloids** such as carrageenan, agar, and alginate are widely used in the food industry as a thickening, gelling, and emulsifying agents. 
 
• **Algae** are the most abundant primary producers, and algae-derived hydrocolloids are high-value thickening, gelling, and emulsifying agents, which have reached **100,000 tons **of annual global production and exceeded **US$ 1.1 billion** of gross market value.
